I, Ramesh Kumar Verma, S/o Late Shri Govind Verma, R/o 45/B Lajpat Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, hereby lodge this complaint. On 15th March 2023, I purchased agricultural land bearing Khasra No. 456/2 measuring 2.5 acres in village Mohanlalganj, District Lucknow from one Suresh Tiwari for Rs. 12,50,000/-. The sale deed was duly executed and registered at the Sub-Registrar Office, Mohanlalganj on 18th March 2023 bearing Registration No. 1234/2023. The accused trio deliberately made incorrect endorsements in the registration records showing Ashok Mishra as purchaser despite knowing I had already purchased the property. When I confronted Suresh Tiwari on 12th August 2023, he threatened me with dire consequences and demanded Rs. 5,00,000/- to withdraw the second sale deed, failing which he said he would get me falsely implicated in criminal cases. On 14th August 2023, Ashok Mishra along with 4-5 unknown persons came to my house and forcibly took away my original sale deed and other property documents. They also assaulted me causing injuries on my head and arms. I reported to Civil Hospital Lucknow where MLC was conducted. The accused persons have committed fraud, criminal intimidation, robbery and caused hurt to me.

They also bribed bank official Suresh Nair with Rs. 12 lakhs on 25th February 2024 to suppress Suspicious Transaction Reports.
